exact_next_execution_gate.action: Run the exact-SHA r3 builder once on the remote repository. It reads/hashes existing artifacts and writes only a small sealed binder receipt; it starts no GPU or EDA work.
exact_next_execution_gate.post_action: Copy only the small sealed binder receipt to a different author for a result hammer. No E1 deployment evaluation or E2-E8 hardware rebind may start before that result hammer passes.
